# Accenture: Latest Results and Fiscal 2027 Outlook

## Most Recent Report: Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Aug. 31, 2026)

Accenture reported results that beat expectations across the board, sending shares up ~18–20%:

| Metric | Q4 FY2026 | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $18.7B | +6% USD / +7% local currency |
| Adjusted EPS | $3.29 | +9% (vs. ~$3.18 est.) |
| New bookings | $22.2B | +4% USD / +5% LC |
| Book-to-bill | 1.2 | — |
| Free cash flow | ~$2.8–2.9B | — |

**Segment detail (Q4):** Managed services $9.4B (+7%), Consulting $9.28B (+6%). By region: Americas $9.4B (+7%), EMEA $6.6B (+6%), Asia Pacific $2.7B (+3%).

**Full-year FY2026:** Revenue $74.2B (+5–6% LC), bookings $84.5B, adjusted EPS $13.97 (+8%), and $11.5B returned to shareholders.

CEO Julie Sweet noted the demand environment for discretionary spending had not "meaningfully changed."

## Fiscal 2027 Guidance

| Metric | FY2027 Guidance |
|---|---|
| Revenue growth | **3%–6% in local currency** (includes ~2–2.5 pts from acquisitions) |
| Operating margin | 15.9%–16.1% (adjusted) |
| GAAP diluted EPS | **$14.39–$14.81** |
| Q1 FY2027 revenue | $18.95B–$19.60B (2%–6% LC growth) |

## Context
- The outlook is viewed as encouraging, with AI demand reportedly broadening into FY2027. Accenture positions AI as a tailwind and a catalyst for client "reinvention."
- Despite the post-earnings surge, ACN remained down roughly 20% year-to-date, trading around ~15x the midpoint of FY27 EPS guidance.
- Some analysts flagged softer bookings visibility as a caveat.

**Sources:**

- [Accenture shares soar on Q4 estimates, fiscal 2027 growth forecasts – Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-shares-soar-fourth-quarter-151100410.html)
- [Accenture Jumps 20% and IBM Climbs on Strong Outlook for 2027 – Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-jumps-20-ibm-climbs-154957520.html)
